source_reviews.observations: Publisher's Materials and Methods / Audio Stimuli describes 15 isolated voice clips (five per synthesized/robot/human category), all repeating sentences from Sophia interviews. Procedure: an online survey asking listeners to assess first impressions of a person and speaker/voice ratings. No sound informed listeners of technical-system or task state and no sound requested a task action. The source is useful for Track G/voice-affect context but does not meet G01 and therefore E2 for Track E.

Preserve Track G relevance; never treat this as an empirical source exclusion until integrator admits a valid SCR and verification.

source_reviews.observations: The publisher-version PDF text says the robot spoke junction options and recommended navigation actions, then delivered mistake and repair utterances. Its in-person maze study recruited 60 people in six between-subject voice×repair conditions (two robot voices × three repairs); behavioural choices and post-task trust measures are reported. The online pilot recruited 50 people via Prolific to judge video-recorded robot repair strategies. These are distinct experiment designs reported within one publication and must not be converted automatically into independent study/sample records.
